title: Captain Marvel Protection - Binary Guard
summary: This Protection build keeps Carol safe behind Armored Vest and Get Behind Me while Counter-Punch and Haymaker turn every block into meaningful damage alongside Photonic Blast. Crisis Interdiction, Bait and Switch, and True Grit form a reliable thwart engine that clears side schemes quickly. Helicarrier, Nick Fury, and flexible protection resources keep the expensive hero kit online so Energy Channel can fuel both plans.
